patch_description:
Reduce the distinct parameter count through strategic parameter sharing while adding richer entanglement patterns. This addresses the worst_group_margin_mean bottleneck by:

1. Sharing RY parameters across all qubits (same rotation applied to all qubits)
2. Sharing RZ pre-layer parameters in pairs (qubits 0-1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-7 share)
3. Sharing RZ post-layer parameters in pairs similarly
4. Adding diagonal cross-entanglement (CZ gates between non-adjacent qubits: 0-2, 1-3, 3-5, 4-6, 5-7) to capture longer-range correlations

This reduces distinct parameters from 24 to 11, dramatically improving parameter efficiency while maintaining expressivity through richer connectivity patterns. The parameter sharing helps the model generalize better from small training sets, which should particularly help with the worst-group margin.
